reason: FreeRTOS MPU ports restrict task access to memory and peripherals. Assessment: this can contain faults from unauthorized task memory access. LegoOS uses backup logs to restore memory after a primary memory component fails. Assessment: this can reduce application failures from memory component faults. reason: Factor checks declared input and output counts before words execute. Its compiler rejects words that fail the stack checker. Reactive-banana provides combinators to filter, merge and accumulate events and compose values that vary with time. Assessment: these shared operations can reduce custom event coordination code. SWI-Prolog documents that default answer tables do not automatically reflect changes to their source predicates. Assessment: stale answers can cause incorrect results after facts change. SQLite documents that stray pointers in a database client cannot corrupt memory in a separate database server process. Assessment: process isolation can contain client memory faults. Plan 9 exposes local and remote resources through file interfaces and the 9P protocol. Applications can use the same file operations for both. Assessment: this can reduce custom resource access code.
